title: Daily internal bar strength dip buy in 200-day uptrend

source.title: Internal Bar Strength IBS Strategy (StockSharp docs)

rule_summary: Daily signals from closed UTC daily candles built from 1h data, executed at the next 1h open. IBS = (close - low) / (high - low) of the daily candle; skip days with zero range. ENTRY when a daily candle closes with IBS < 0.2 AND daily close > SMA(200 days) AND no open position. EXIT when a later daily candle closes with IBS >= 0.8. Safety exit: daily close below the 200-day SMA. Optional hard stop 12% below entry. Long only, one position per pair, whole balance. The source uses 0.2 and 0.8 thresholds on 4h bars with no trend filter; the 200-day filter and daily frame are my adaptation.
mechanism: A close near the day's low in an uptrend often reflects forced selling or liquidity-driven pressure at the end of the day. Dip buyers who provide liquidity are paid when price reverts the next sessions. The source gives no mechanism; this is the usual short-term reversal / liquidity-provision explanation.
